note: PROTOTYPE — the questions the lesson timeline's first version exists to answer (PLAN_LESSON_TIMELINE.md). The web server syncs these into the questions table at boot; the rail shows them on the lesson page.

questions.prompt: How long did it take to get from logged bricks to a lesson you'd watch? (under 5 min, 5–15, 15–30, over 30)
Did the preview play the way the rendered file plays? (yes / mostly / no — what differed?)
Did starting with every brick in filmed order help, or would you rather start empty?
Was cut-or-dissolve enough, or what transition did you reach for?
What did you want to do on the strip that you couldn't?
